name: AstaAkuma
shortDescription: A heavyweight oversized silhouette built around a dark crimson warrior graphic and relentless streetwear energy.
fullDescription: A statement oversized T-shirt built for a darker visual language. The deep black base is layered with an intense crimson graphic featuring a lone warrior surrounded by smoke, destruction, and a burning red moon. Distressed textures and high-contrast artwork create a raw, battle-worn aesthetic, while the oversized drop-shoulder silhouette keeps the garment relaxed and contemporary. Designed for those who carry an unapologetic presence, this piece brings anime-inspired darkness into modern streetwear.
care: Machine wash cold inside-out. Hang dry in shade.
